rounds.text: Prime Fresh Ltd is demonstrating exceptional fundamental momentum that vastly outpaces its current market valuation, driven by a 10-year compounded sales growth of 28% and a 5-year profit growth CAGR of 39.1% [E8, E53]. This stellar financial performance is underscored by a robust ROCE of 19.7% and an ROE of 15.0%, both of which comfortably outstrip the sector median ROCE of 10.2% [E6, E7, E69]. Market sentiment has clearly lagged behind these operational achievements, with a reverse DCF showing that today's price of ₹ 191 implies a modest 9.6% earnings growth against the 18.0% base case assumption, creating a significant margin of safety [E2, E38, E40]. Furthermore, a discounted cash flow valuation places intrinsic value at ₹ 352 per share, offering a substantial 45.8% margin of safety [E38, E39]. The company remains conservatively financed with a low debt-to-equity ratio of 0.08x, highlighting a pristine balance sheet that supports its strong growth trajectory [E31]. Conceded: promoter holding has decreased over the last 3 years to 50.75% and operating cash flow was negative at Rs -1 Cr in Mar 2026 [E28, E34, E56].
